title: SearchSnippet/get does not cap emailIds (requestTooLarge)
description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/snippet.rs handle_search_snippet_get accepts any number of emailIds. RFC 8621 §5.1 SearchSnippet/get lists requestTooLarge for 'The number of emailIds requested by the client exceeds the maximum number the server is willing to process in a single method call.' JMAP-yt1w.31 added enforce_max_objects_in_get (counts RFC 8620 'ids' only) and wired it into every /get that takes ids; SearchSnippet/get takes emailIds so it was left out. Decide which cap applies (maxObjectsInGet or a separate one) and enforce it.
notes:
Fixed in snippet.rs: emailIds count checked against JmapBackend::max_objects_in_get before parsing; over cap -> requestTooLarge (description maxObjectsInGet) per RFC 8621 §5.1. Regression tests in tests/search_snippet_request_too_large.rs pass. Uncommitted.
Done in 2641a8fc: tests search_snippet_get_over_cap_returns_request_too_large, search_snippet_get_at_cap_is_processed; changed existing tests: none
